description: This file defines the TypesHelper class, providing static utility methods for handling data types, including size determination and type conversion, likely used in a larger codebase related to configuration or data structure management.

classes.name: TypesHelper
classes.description: Utility class containing static methods for data type size calculation, type conversion to TypeScript types, and type checks.

methods.name: getElementSize
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a given type, based on the current ReaderState context.

methods.name: convertToTs
methods.description: Converts a Java type string to an equivalent TypeScript type string.

methods.name: isFloat
methods.description: Checks if the given type string represents a floating point type.
